description.content:
Bazaarvoice Developer Space V2.0 Content Search API. Provides programmatic search and retrieval of user-generated content (UGC) - Reviews, Questions, Answers, Contributor profiles - plus product catalog lookahead search and structured data (JSON-LD/Microdata) for products. Assembled by API Evangelist from the per-operation OpenAPI definitions published on developers.bazaarvoice.com reference pages.

Contact Support:
 Name: Bazaarvoice Developer Support
